The best structure from my own searches was a fit with NMSE around 6.6e-3, also not exact. I ran out of tool calls (14 of 14) before finding the two missing terms.

best.code:
def equation(t, P, params):
    return params[0]*P**2 + params[1]*t*np.log(1+params[2]*P) + params[3]*P*t + params[4]*P*np.log(t) + params[5]*np.sqrt(t)*P*np.log(1+params[6]*P) + params[7]*t*np.tanh(params[8]*P) + params[9]*np.sqrt(t)
